vegetation_change.vintage: 2017 high-resolution imagery compared with the 2000 NPS vegetation map (1994/1996 imagery)
vegetation_change.interpretation_note: Shows mapped vegetation cover type, density or pattern change and proposed reasons from the USGS release; not a present-day 2026 vegetation map.

horne_fire.vintage: 2021 Horne Fire; USGS data release published 2024
horne_fire.interpretation_note: Burn-severity assessment derived from pre/post-fire high-resolution imagery; use as historical ecological context, not a current fire-status layer.
